rows.original_comment: Freeze the primitive-cycle ownership convention, including labeled versus symmetry-reduced coding, cyclic rotation, time reversal, disk-label symmetries, multiplicities, and the map from each accepted code class to one realized physical periodic orbit.
rows.authors_claim: We have frozen the prospective owner convention on the labeled alphabet {1,2,3}: every accepted oriented primitive owner has one primitive-ledger row and multiplicity one; cyclic rotations add no multiplicity; reversal is a separately linked owner counted once in each direction; disk-label permutations are neither quotiented nor turned into a degeneracy factor; and an r-th traversal is only repetition of the same owner. rows.original_comment: Add one consolidated six-gate dependency and state surface that shows inputs, outputs, hashes, uncertainty channels, consumers, stop states, downstream permissions, and the distinction among not started, prerequisite-blocked, evaluable, passed, failed, and not evaluable.
rows.authors_claim: We have consolidated the six gates into one hash-linked directed acyclic graph and one closed state vocabulary. Each gate row is required to carry typed inputs, outputs, receipts, uncertainty records, consumer fields, and a prohibition field, while a generic downstream firewall blocks consumption unless the declared prerequisite state and hashes close. The revision distinguishes NOT_STARTED, PREREQUISITE_BLOCKED, EVALUABLE, PASSED, FAILED, and NOT_EVALUABLE, with NOT_ACTIVATED reserved for Gate 6, and records every gate as currently NOT_STARTED.

rows.original_comment: Define whether Gate 6 lies outside the minimum physical-determinant certificate and state the exact preconditions that activate the optional directional nontransfer module.
